title: Klaus G
content: It was December 17, 2019. I had just returned from a business trip. My mother had become a nursing case and was living in a small town 100 kilometers away. My wife and I were planning to visit her for Christmas in three days. That was the plan. On December 17, 2019, I returned from a client meeting and sat in my office to finish the report and invoice. Over the years, I had developed this little ritual. It was my last client meeting of the year, and I shut down the computer feeling satisfied. Now, Christmas could come. After closing my laptop, I suddenly felt sick out of nowhere. I didn’t know where this discomfort came from, but it unsettled me. I wondered if I was having a heart attack. I had worked a lot, and it had been a tough year. I asked myself if I should call an ambulance as the nausea grew worse. But inside, I was strangely calm. I told myself, "No, this has nothing to do with my heart." I went to the sofa, sat down, and leaned back. The nausea was still there. I looked through the large window, breathed deeply, and grew calmer. Then tunnel vision set in. I couldn’t close my eyes as I stared into the darkness. Suddenly, I was moving through a tunnel. I didn’t know who was around me, but I took hold of a hand. We walked straight ahead into a wonderful white light that was radiating kindness. In the light, our hands separated. I returned to my body. I shook my head, and the nausea was gone. At first, I didn’t know what to make of it. I was still sitting on the sofa when my phone rang. It was my father, telling me my mother had just passed away and that I should come. "Wow," I said to him. "I know, I was just there." It suddenly became clear to me. Two hours later, I arrived and saw my mother lying peacefully in her bed. The neighbor was still there and took me aside, saying she had something to tell me. She had been with my mother since that afternoon and said she had been doing very well. She even wanted to get out of bed, telling the neighbor, "Klaus is coming by today." The neighbor reassured her, telling her that I wasn’t coming until Christmas in a few days since I still had business trips. But my mother wouldn’t be swayed. Four hours after that conversation with the neighbor, I was there. She had been right, and I’m proud I could accompany her on her final journey.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Death of my mother, Other (briefly specify), Working in the office
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, Everything felt clear and coherent
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes, It was a very long tunnel. At first all I saw was the dark walls. Then, gradually the tunnel became brighter, until reaching a dazzling light.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, I could feel a hand that I held.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: Some unfamiliar and strange place, It was the door to another place.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will, I let go of the hand because I was only a companion; that was clear to me.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, I felt a strong connection with the hand I held.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, I realized that I had accompanied my mother in death, even though I couldn't be with her. There were 100 kilometers between us.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Uncertain, It became clear to me that there is something beyond the light.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: This experience didn't change me much, as I've had other similar experiences before.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I still remember exactly how I came out of the "trance." Immediately I heard my father's phone ring. He informed me that my mother had died.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: What surprised me was the strength of my mother's call to go with her. When it happened, I was still completely in my head and rational mind; I had just been writing reports and invoices and wasn't in a meditative state.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, The physical symptoms, including spontaneous nausea, was noticeable. The journey through the tunnel felt authentic. Just as spontaneously, I returned, and the nausea was immediately gone.
